headline: GNS plans to forcibly close more than 66 thousand inactive companies and sole proprietorships » Gazeta.kg - Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek news today
summary: Kyrgyzstan's State Tax Service has started the third stage of forced liquidation of inactive legal entities and cancellation of tax registration for some sole proprietors. A new list of affected entities was published.
why: Kyrgyzstan is a small Central Asian economy with a large informal business sector, and tax-registry clean-ups affect the business environment and government revenue tracking.
